# WO-2026-08-13-02 — One canonical state, one truthful sentence

## Acceptance criteria

> **⛔ WARWICK'S FRAMING.** *"Cockpit is the primary interactive control surface. Telegram is ingestion +
> notifications. The normal Cockpit experience must be HUMAN-READABLE, RELEVANT, INFORMATIVE, **NOT A
> DATABASE VIEW**."* And: *"Do not make Warwick reconcile contradictory counts or labels himself."*

**AC1 — RESOLVE THE PLACEHOLDER STATE-FIELD MISMATCH. This is the seam and it comes first.**
`canonicalState.js` reads a **placeholder** field name; the real column is **`asdair.shop.human_state`**
(migration 020). Warwick: *"Do not merge two 'complete' branches that disagree at their seam."* Reconcile
against the ACTUAL canonical field, and **prove by execution that the value read is the value written** —
not by reading the code.

**AC2 — ONE CANONICAL HUMAN-FACING STATE, closed set.** At minimum, cleanly distinguished: **AsdAIr
working · Needs Warwick · Ready for Warwick · Browser working · Complete · Failed.** One state, derived
once. **Two surfaces must never be able to disagree about which state a shop is in.**

**AC3 — "WHY ISN'T MY BASKET READY?" — ONE truthful sentence.** Warwick's own examples are the
specification: *"2 decisions still need you." · "Nothing needs you. AsdAIr is reconciling 3 products." ·
"Everything is resolved. Ready to build the ASDA basket." · "Basket build failed. Nothing was ordered."*
⛔ *"Never require Warwick to infer this from several counters."*
**Derive the sentence from the SAME data as the counts**, so a counter and the sentence cannot contradict
each other. **Test that they cannot** — construct a state where a naive implementation would disagree, and
assert it does not.

**AC4 — THE PROVENANCE BREAKDOWN, exposed as data for the UI.** This week's shop must be answerable:
source read status · source-line count · interpreted/reconciled products · total planned products and
items · **what came from PHOTO · what was ADDED FROM REGULARS · what came from HOUSEHOLD RULES · what was
decided by WARWICK · what was SKIPPED** · what genuinely remains unresolved · whether anything blocks the
basket · whether AsdAIr is working · whether Warwick must act.
⛔ **The four provenance origins must stay distinct in the API, never collapsed.** PHOTO is not REGULARS;
REGULARS is not RULE; RULE is not HUMAN.

**AC5 — THE QUESTION / UNCERTAINTY BOARD, backend side.** One coherent board: **all questions still needing
Warwick · answers already accepted · what remains · whether anything blocks the shop.** Per unresolved line
where useful: **the application-owned image crop**, what AsdAIr interpreted, the proposed catalogue match,
genuinely useful alternatives.
**Warwick must be able to:** answer in free text · choose a candidate · **correct an already-resolved
item** · **mark something "not this week"** · see immediately that the answer was accepted · see what
remains. Where meaningful, distinguish **applied to this shop** from **remembered for future shops**.
⛔ **A successfully reconciled line must NOT remain on the board through stale needs-human state.**

**AC6 — THE TWO NAMED RESIDUES.** `shopLines.markCorrected` has no production caller: wire it at
`runPipeline.js`'s `stepApplyCorrections`, resolving the string `item_name` vs integer `lineNo` shape
mismatch honestly rather than casting past it. And **build the missing "not this week" command** for an
already-resolved line (AC5 requires it).

**AC7 — EXCEPTION-FIRST LIST DATA.** Warwick: *"Warwick is NOT going to proofread 39 lines every week."*
The API must let the UI default to **needs attention · changes/additions · unresolved exceptions**, with
resolved lines available compactly. Support the summary shape: **39 from photograph + N Regulars − N
skipped = N final products / N items.**

**AC8 — RULES, human-readable.** Expose the agreed rule treatment in human terms (*"Never automatically
substitute products — applies to every shop"*, *"Cravendale Semi-Skimmed — usually buy 4 × 2L"*).
⛔ **Do NOT expose arbitrary SQL or data mechanics, and do NOT pretend broad rule CRUD exists if it does
not.** Expose only what the bounded authorised mechanism actually supports, and say plainly what it does
not.

**AC9 — start the service locally, verify, stop it.** Prove the converged state model against real data,
not fixtures alone. **A restart is not a fix** — Warwick: *"do not use 'restart fixed it' as a substitute
for fixing a genuinely incoherent user-facing state model."*

## Required evidence

- The Cockpit and AsdAIr suites, executed, asserting **reported counts** and naming them. Report the pre- and post- figures; nothing may regress.
- **AC1 proof by execution**: the value written to `asdair.shop.human_state` is the value the backend reads back. Not a code reading.
- **AC3 contradiction test**: a state where a naive implementation would let a counter and the sentence disagree, asserted not to.
- **AC5 stale-referral test**: a reconciled line asserted absent from the question board.
- `bash scripts/secret-scan.sh --surface services/cockpit` → exit code AND coverage. Exit 2 is NOT SCANNED, never a pass.
- `bash scripts/secret-scan.sh --surface services/cockpit services/asdair` → report exit code AND coverage. Exit 2 is NOT SCANNED, never a pass

## Explicitly out of scope — report, never fix

- **The Cockpit UI** — a parallel Work Order is running against `build-015/b15-26-cockpit-ui` right now. **Do not touch UI files.** Publish the API the UI needs and report the contract.
- **Vision, reconciliation, final-list creation, browser handoff** — separate parallel lanes. Do not build them.
- **Any migration or DDL**, any destructive statement, any production data mutation.
- **Browser, ASDA session, checkout, payment, slot** — categorically forbidden.
- Anything requiring broad rule CRUD that does not exist. **Report the gap; do not invent the mechanism.**

## Sequencing

**0. READ-BACK, then HOLD — SHORT.** Warwick is asleep and three lanes are running in parallel. Name what
is wrong and proceed unless it is genuinely blocking.

**1. AC1 — the state-field seam FIRST.** Everything else is built on it, and merging two "complete" branches
that disagree at their seam is what Warwick explicitly forbade.
**2. AC2 → AC3** — one state, one sentence, and the test that they cannot contradict.
**3. AC4 → AC5 → AC6 → AC7 → AC8.**
**4. AC9** — start it, verify against real data, stop it.

**Git: COMMIT and PUSH the branch. NO PR.** Work from `82e7618`; do not merge `main`.

**⚠️ A PARALLEL UI WORKER IS CONSUMING YOUR API.** Publish the shape early in your return and flag any
change to it prominently — **Larry is integrating both and a seam disagreement is exactly the failure this
order exists to prevent.**

**Return to Larry** with the API contract, the AC1 execution proof, the contradiction test, what you wired,
